description: The dependency policy of ADR 0001 and infra/security/README.md: exact pins, at most a weekly batch, nothing younger than two weeks, and overrides changed only by a person, in pnpm-workspace.yaml. Each version change also updates docs/adr/0001-stack.md.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Off: it would bring in transitive releases younger than two weeks. A transitive fix goes through an override in pnpm-workspace.yaml once its release is old enough (RRR-242).

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Opened at once, whatever the schedule. A release younger than two weeks needs the owner's security exception, recorded in ADR 0001, before it merges.

packageRules.description: An override is a decision with its reason written beside it in pnpm-workspace.yaml (infra/security/README.md), so Renovate lists it on the dashboard and opens a pull request only when a person asks.
Pin GitHub Actions only to releases at least two weeks old (Section 9 supply chain, A94). CI checks each pinned SHA against its tag (infra/security/src/action-pins.ts).
typescript-eslint caps TypeScript below 6.1 (ADR 0001). Hold TypeScript until it widens.
stylelint-use-logical-spec supports stylelint below 17 (ADR 0001, deviation 4). Hold stylelint until it widens.
pnpm moves only together with the Node runtime (ADR 0001, deviation 2), so both wait for a person.
Compass pins Expo's bundled set, and the renderer needs an exact React match (ADR 0001, deviation 6). These move with an Expo SDK upgrade, not one at a time.
clamd's image is pinned in both the local compose file and the Fly.io Dockerfile, and they move together (infra/runbooks/production.md, Upload scanning).
